note: PREPARED ONLY. No action in this queue is authorized or executed. Every entry defaults to authorization_status=NOT_AUTHORIZED / executed_status=NOT_EXECUTED with no authorization_evidence. Claude may prepare these actions; Claude may NOT perform them. One future authorization authorizes exactly one action_id -- there is no bundled consent. A draft, a checklist, or a queued action never changes any reference's registry state.
burden_scale: Burden is a relative operational-effort estimate for the shortest legitimate resolution route: 1 = one written question round; 2 = a question round with a scope-dependent follow-up or an account-setting step with verification; 4 = a negotiated contract. It says nothing about the probability the provider answers favorably. Ranked by BLOCKER RESOLUTION TRACTABILITY only, never by model quality.

actions.purpose: Ask Alibaba Cloud Model Studio support whether automated internal benchmarking is permitted, whether outputs may be scored/retained internally, and whether a dated snapshot (e.g. qwen3.8-max-0902) is immutable and identifiable from response metadata.
actions.evidence_required_after_execution: Tier B official Alibaba Cloud written reply, or Tier A published terms/model-version documentation, answering QWN-Q1..QWN-Q8 verbatim, saved, timestamped and SHA-256 hashed.
actions.expected_state_transition: IF verified: license_or_terms_status REVIEW_REQUIRED->CLEAR; evidence_retention_status REVIEW_REQUIRED->PERMITTED; automated_evaluation_status REVIEW_REQUIRED->CLEAR; model_identity_attributable FALSE->TRUE; reference_evaluation_admission_status REVIEW_REQUIRED->ADMITTED. private_holdout_status stays PERMITTED. access_preflight_status is NOT changed by the reply; only promote_access_status() can change it.
actions.expiry_or_freshness_requirement: Reply stale after 90 days or on any Alibaba terms/model-lifecycle revision; dated-snapshot identifier must be re-confirmed immediately before any future run.
actions.notes: Private-holdout PERMITTED (Model Studio customer-data-policy statements) is preserved and not reopened absent contradictory evidence. Teacher use stays BLOCKED and is not part of this action.
actions.burden_rationale: One email, but model-identity attributability additionally needs verifiable version documentation, not just a yes.
actions.owner_instruction: Send the QWN packet email from an ORNEUR business address to Alibaba Cloud Model Studio support; forward the raw reply (with headers) to the evidence intake.
actions.risk_cost: Free. Low risk. Do not attach any private holdout material.
